doc.title: rustybt - Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR41: System can present discovered discrepancies for investigation. FR42-43: Link discrepancies to source code. FR44: Track investigation notes. FR45-48: Classify as BUG or DESIGN with rationale.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: rustybt-validate investigate <session_id> [--layer data] - Investigation mode CLI for classifying findings. Click-based with prompt for interactive input.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: All findings must be classified as BUG or DESIGN. findings.yaml stores classification with rationale, investigated_by, investigated_at. Unclassified findings block validation completion.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Finding dataclass with id, layer, description, classification (BUG/DESIGN/None), rationale, investigated_by, investigated_at, resolved, rustybt_value, backtrader_value.

doc.title: Epic 5: Investigation & Classification Workflow
doc.snippet: Goal: Enable systematic investigation and classification of discrepancies. Covers FR41-FR54. Value: Every discrepancy is investigated, classified, and either fixed or documented.

python.package: CLI framework for commands, options, arguments, prompts

constraints.constraint: Follow Click-based CLI pattern established in cli.py
Use existing SessionManager for loading sessions
Finding classification must be one of: BUG, DESIGN, or None (unclassified)
Valid layers: data, signals, orders, broker, portfolio
Use Click.prompt for interactive input in investigation loop
All actions must be logged to session's activity log
NFR16: Test reports must be clear and actionable
NFR17: Show expected and actual values side-by-side
NFR19: Investigation workflow must guide user through classification
